annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds personal delivery device operators (who must carry liability insurance and identify the device) and political subdivisions (which are limited in regulating such devices).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A personal delivery device operator shall maintain an insurance policy that provides general liability coverage of at least One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000.00)
annotation.dates_quote: This act shall become effective November 1, 2021.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: equipped with automated driving technology, including software and hardware, that enables the operation of the device with remote support and supervision;
